prompt:
A sprite sheet of separate harbour-town props for a top-down pixel-art RPG, seen from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top and the front face). Arrange 12 props in a loose 4 x 3 grid with wide empty space between them, every prop fully separate, none touching or overlapping: wooden barrel with iron hoops, wooden crate, burlap sack, wooden bench, iron street lamp post (tall, lamp unlit, glass pane), stone well with wooden roof, market stall with striped red-cream awning and fruit, notice board on two legs with papers, coil of fishing net with floats, mooring bollard, small rowboat, clay flower pot with red flowers.
Scale: a barrel is about 20 art pixels wide; the lamp post about 60 art pixels tall.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels.
revised_prompt: Create a single transparent-background sprite sheet for a top-down pixel-art RPG. Twelve distinct harbour-town prop sprites in a loose 4-column x 3-row grid, widely spaced with transparent empty gutters; all fully visible, separate, no touching or overlaps. Arrange row 1: wooden barrel with iron hoops, wooden crate, burlap sack, wooden bench. Row 2: tall iron street lamp post with unlit glass lantern, stone well with wooden roof, market stall with red-and-cream striped awning and fruit, notice board on two legs with small blank/unreadable papers. Row 3: coil of fishing net with floats, mooring bollard, small rowboat, clay flower pot with red flowers. Consistent classic three-quarter top-down JRPG view showing tops and front faces. Consistent relative scale: barrel roughly 20 ART pixels wide; lamp roughly 60 ART pixels tall. Premium hand-placed high-bit pixel art, uniform crisp square pixels throughout (each art pixel roughly 8x8 output pixels), hard pixelated edges, clean clustered forms in groups of 3–10 pixels; no antialiasing, no blur, no brush effects, no photo textures, no random noise, no checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy worn-in materials, 4–6 shades per material, warm-yellow shifted highlights and saturated purple/red shifted shadows. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting, clean base colors only; no cast shadows, no ground, no drop shadows, no glow, no light pools, no nighttime effect, no vignette. Background truly transparent with alpha, including spaces between sprites. No labels, letters, UI, border, or text.
